Tiffany & Co. (TIF) Analysts See $0.84 EPS
May 17, 2018 - By Winifred Garcia
Analysts expect Tiffany & Co. (NYSE:TIF) to report $0.84 EPS on May, 23 before the open.They anticipate $0.10 EPS change or 13.51 % from last quarter’s $0.74 EPS. TIF’s profit would be $104.58 million giving it 31.15 P/E if the $0.84 EPS is correct. After having $1.67 EPS previously, Tiffany & Co.’s analysts see -49.70 % EPS growth. The stock increased 0.60% or $0.62 during the last trading session, reaching $104.67. About 126,210 shares traded. Tiffany & Co. (NYSE:TIF) has risen 1.55% since May 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 10.00% the S&P500. Tiffany & Co. (NYSE:TIF) Ratings Coverage
Among 15 analysts covering Tiffany & Co ( NYSE:TIF ), 8 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 7 Hold. Therefore 53% are positive. Tiffany & Co had 20 analyst reports since November 21, 2017 according to SRatingsIntel. As per Thursday, April 5, the company rating was upgraded by Loop Capital. On Thursday, November 30 the stock rating was maintained by Cowen & Co with “Buy”. The firm earned “Hold” rating on Wednesday, January 17 by Wells Fargo. The stock of Tiffany & Co. (NYSE:TIF) has “Buy” rating given on Thursday, December 14 by Citigroup. As per Friday, December 1, the company rating was upgraded by KeyBanc Capital Markets. J.P. Morgan initiated the stock with “Hold” rating in Monday, December 18 report. The firm has “Buy” rating given on Sunday, March 18 by Cowen & Co. The stock of Tiffany & Co. (NYSE:TIF) has “Buy” rating given on Friday, May 4 by Oppenheimer. The stock of Tiffany & Co. (NYSE:TIF) earned “Hold” rating by Wells Fargo on Thursday, January 11. RBC Capital Markets maintained the shares of TIF in report on Wednesday, November 29 with “Hold” rating.
Tiffany & Co., through its subsidiaries, designs, makes, and retails jewelry and other items worldwide. The company has market cap of $13.03 billion. The Company’s jewelry products include fine and solitaire jewelry; engagement rings and wedding bands; and non-gemstone, sterling silver, and gold jewelry. It has a 35.36 P/E ratio. The firm also sells timepieces, leather goods, sterling silverware, china, crystal, stationery, fragrances, and accessories.
